title: Pull-back of the co-area integral to the straightening chart
statement: Let N, m, k ∈ ℕ, M ⊆ ℝᴺ, f : ℝᴺ → ℝᵐ, and P := WithLp 2 (ℝᵐ × ℝᵏ) with its Lebesgue measure (volume) dp. Let j : ℝᵏ → P be the continuous linear map (WithLp.prodContinuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ ℝᵐ ℝᵏ).symm ∘L inr, so j(b) = toLp(0,b). Let Ω ⊆ P be open and let Ψ : P → ℝᴺ be C¹ on Ω and injective on Ω, with DΨ(p) injective for every p ∈ Ω. Assume that for every p ∈ Ω: f is differentiable at Ψ(p), f(Ψ p) = WithLp.fst p, and tangentSpace M (Ψ p) = range DΨ(p). Let S ⊆ Ψ(Ω) be a Borel set and g : ℝᴺ → [0,∞] any function. Assume (hLA): for every x ∈ ℝᴺ and all continuous linear maps A : P → ℝᴺ, B : ℝᵏ → ℝᴺ such that A is injective, tangentSpace M x = range A, Df(x)(A q) = WithLp.fst q for all q ∈ P, and B b = A(toLp(0,b)) for all b ∈ ℝᵏ, one has coareaJacobian M f x · normDet(A) = normDet(B), where normDet is Mathlib's LinearMap.normDet. Then ∫_S g·ofReal(coareaJacobian M f) dμHE[m+k] = ∫_{Ω∩Ψ⁻¹(S)} ofReal(normDet(DΨ(p)∘j))·g(Ψ p) dp.
